values.note: Online only, paid in full before setting up; each season's reservations open the first Monday of February at 9 a.m. No maximum stay.

note: City of River Falls campground in Hoffman Park, beside ball fields, disc golf and the city's baseball stadium; camp host usually in RV site 9. Campfires are not permitted (some shared grills). --Claude
